name: Almendral de la Cañada (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow with a blue triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Almendral de la Cañada.
history: The municipal flag was officially approved on 18 May 1992 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 22 May 1992: rectangular, of proportions 3:5, divided horizontally into two parts of equal width, green above and yellow below, with a blue triangle whose base is the hoist edge and whose apex is the centre of the flag, bearing the crowned arms of the municipality.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
Almendral de la Cañada arms — tower on green, bezants on blue and an almond tree
